SUMMARY
Welcome to Dakeith house, BH1. This property is a two bedroom top floor apartment situated within Bournemouth town centre. The property is to be sold with no onward chain and has a spacious living room, separate kitchen and is the perfect first time purchase.

DESCRIPTION
Offered to the market with no onward chain, Dalkeith House, is a charming two-bedroom apartment set within a distinguished Grade II listed building, rich in character and architectural interest.

The apartment offers well-proportioned accommodation, comprising two bedrooms, providing flexibility for owner-occupiers, guests, or home-working space. The property benefits from the period features and character expected of a building of this nature, while offering practical and comfortable living.

Dalkeith House occupies a convenient and sought-after position, within easy reach of Bournemouth town centre, local amenities, transport links, and the seafront, making it an attractive option for both residential purchasers and investors alike.

With its historic setting, central location, and the advantage of no onward chain, this property presents an excellent opportunity to acquire a character apartment in one of Bournemouth’s most recognisable buildings.

Lounge 17'  x 10' 5" extending to 12' 9" ( 5.18m x 3.17m extending to 3.89m )
Two rear aspect single glazed windows, side aspect single glazed window, radiator.

Kitchen 11' 10" x 9' 4" ( 3.61m x 2.84m )
side aspect single glazed window, wall and base units, gas hob, electric oven, wall mounted combination boiler, tiled over counter

Bedroom 1 16' 3" x 9' 11" ( 4.95m x 3.02m )
radiator, rear aspect double glazed velux window,

Bedroom 2 11' 7" x 6' 9" ( 3.53m x 2.06m )
rear aspect double glazed velux window, radiator behind the door

Bathroom 7' 2" x 6' 11" ( 2.18m x 2.11m )
Radiator, WC, wash hand basin, vinyl flooring, bath with shower over, tiled walls

Agents Note
